cases.title: Login page
cases.situation: A person who already has an account opens the product and is not signed in.

options.title: Centered column
options.useWhen: The product has one way in, and most people sign in with email and a password.

options.title: Brand beside the form
options.useWhen: First-time visitors land here and need one line on what the product is.

options.title: Provider first
options.useWhen: Most people sign in with Google, GitHub or Apple; email is the fallback.

options.title: Email only
options.useWhen: An internal tool with no passwords: the person gets a sign-in link by email.

do: Put the error above the fields, in an inline Alert.
Keep 'Forgot password?' next to the password field's button, as a text-only Button.
Name the provider on its button: 'Continue with Google'.
dont: Do not clear the email field after a failed attempt.
Do not show sign-up fields on the login page; link or tab to sign-up.
cases.native: On Apple use `SignInWithAppleButton` for Apple, a grouped form for the fields, and system buttons.
